title: Quotation: It would be better for him that a millstone were tied about his neck…
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a quotation.

It would be better for him that a millstone were tied about his neck and that he were cast into the depths of the sea rather than that he should scandalise one of these, my least little ones.

anchor.text: It would be better for him that a millstone were tied about his neck and that he were cast into the depths of the sea rather than that he should scandalise one of these, my least little ones.
